name: mobile-release
description: Ship an iOS or Android build to testers and stores without reusing a build number or shipping an OTA bundle that crashes on launch. Covers version and build-number policy, code signing done by the project's own tooling, TestFlight / Play internal / Firebase uploads, Maestro on the uploaded build, phased rollout and halt, OTA runtime compatibility, and the store hand-off.
